home.title: Dashboard

onboard.reconfigure_subtitle: Empty fields keep the current value.
onboard.api_key_saved: Saved — leave empty to keep it
onboard.model_fallback: Live list unavailable, showing the default model
onboard.model_discover_hint: Enter the base URL and API key first.
onboard.capabilities_desc: Skills to install and built-in tools to enable.
onboard.skills_desc: None by default. Skill folders are added, never removed.
onboard.tools_desc: All enabled by default. Uncheck to disable.
onboard.channels_desc: Telegram and Discord bots for this agent.
onboard.token_saved: Saved — leave empty to keep it
onboard.access_desc: Who may talk to the agent, and its periodic self-check.

onboard.prefill_failed: Could not load the current setup: {error}
onboard.restart_confirm: Restart {name} so the new configuration takes effect?

chat.title: Chat
chat.subtitle: Talk to the selected agent with streaming, tools, and approvals.
chat.placeholder: Send a message... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.empty: No messages yet. Start the conversation.

server.title: Server
server.subtitle: Start, stop, and restart the agent daemon.
server.controls_desc: Changes apply to the selected agent only.
server.note_desc: Restart after changing provider or channel tokens, queue workers, or observability settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account and session.
settings.app_settings_desc: Language and appearance for this browser.
settings.password_desc: Changing the password signs out every session.
settings.password_too_short: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
settings.session_note: Tokens are valid for 24 hours and are cleared when the control plane restarts.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.subtitle: Shell on the machine running the API.
terminal.host_warning: Runs on the API host, as the user running myaaw.
terminal.session_note: The connection dropped. Reconnect to attach to the same shell while it is still alive; nothing runs in the background once it expires.
terminal.failed_hint: Reconnect to try again. If another tab is still connected to this agent, close it first or wait about two minutes for the old session to expire.
terminal.disabled_desc: Shells are off by default because they grant full access to the machine running the API. Restart the control plane with the flag below to turn them on.

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Browse /home, /skills, and /jobs, then edit text files.
files.new_name: Name for a new file or folder
files.select_file: Select a file to edit it.
files.preview_unavailable: No preview available for this file type.
files.preview_failed: This browser cannot display the file. Download it instead.
files.too_large: File is too large to preview.

context.title: Context
context.subtitle: Edit the identity, memory, and instruction files the agent reads.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Enable, inspect, and remove agent skills.
skills.empty_desc: Skills are created by the agent or copied into the agent's skills folder.
skills.builtin_desc: Embedded skills you can add to this agent.
skills.select: Select a skill to inspect it.
skills.binary: Binary file — preview is not available.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Manage LLM providers and discover their models.
providers.empty_desc: Add a provider to start chatting with an agent.
providers.create_desc: API keys are write-only and masked after saving.
providers.name: Name

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Connect Telegram and Discord to the selected agent.
channels.telegram_desc: Bot API over polling or webhook.
channels.token_hint: Leave empty to keep the stored token.
channels.disable_confirm: Disable this channel? The token is kept.
channels.restart_hint: Restart the agent server after changing tokens.

config.title: Config
config.subtitle: Agent settings, heartbeat, observability, and approvals.
config.bot_desc: Loop limits, timeouts, and channel behaviour.
config.repeat_tool_call_limit_hint: Warn the model after this many identical tool calls. 0 disables the warning.
config.reset_confirm: Reset this tab to the template defaults? Saved values in it are lost.
config.reset_all_confirm: Reset the whole config to the template defaults? This also clears providers and channels for this agent.
config.obs_desc: Traces and cost; prices are stored in a separate file.
config.restart_hint: Restart the agent server for queue worker and observability changes to take effect.

tools.title: Available Tools
tools.subtitle: Toggle built-in tools and register custom or MCP tools.
tools.builtin_desc: These can only be enabled or disabled.
tools.mcp_desc: Model Context Protocol servers spawned by the agent.
tools.name: Name

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.subtitle: A2A agents this agent can delegate tasks to.
contacts.empty_desc: Add an A2A peer to let this agent delegate work.
contacts.create_desc: The URL must be an absolute http(s) address.
contacts.edit_desc: Changing the name renames the contact. Fields left as they are stay untouched.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.token_hint: Leave empty when the remote agent is open.
contacts.token_hint_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored token.

cron.title: Cron
cron.subtitle: Scheduled prompts delivered to a channel.
cron.jobs_desc: Running a job requires the agent server to be up.
cron.scheduler_desc: Master switch for every job of this agent.
cron.scheduler_hint: The agent reads this when it starts, so restart the server for a change to take effect.
cron.empty_desc: Create a cron, interval, or one-time job.
cron.create_desc: Cron uses five fields; every uses a duration; at uses a timestamp.
cron.name: Name

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Tail a log file over SSE.
logs.files_desc: Files under the agent's logs directory.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Archive agent directories and restore them from the browser.
backups.dir_hint: Archives are written here. Set MYAAW_BACKUP_DIR to move them.
backups.create_desc: One archive per agent, plus the registry when every agent is included.
backups.create_desc_agent: One archive of {agent}, with the options below.
backups.scope_agents_hint: Pick the agents to archive. The registry is only included when every agent is selected.
backups.pick_agent: Pick at least one agent, or choose all agents.
backups.include_workspace_hint: Generated files, uploads, and media the agent kept.
backups.include_venv_hint: Large, and rebuildable from the recorded packages.
backups.no_secrets_hint: Redact tokens and API keys so the archive is safe to share.
backups.archives_desc: Every tar.gz in the backup directory, newest first.
backups.empty_desc: Create one to get a portable copy of an agent.
backups.empty_desc_agent: Create one to get a portable copy of {agent}.
backups.restore_hint: Replaces the files of {agent}. The daemon is stopped while this runs and a pre-restore archive is written first.
backups.restore_as_hint: Optional. Leave empty to keep the archived name {agent}.
backups.delete_confirm: Delete this archive? This cannot be undone.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Effective policy and the grants stored for this agent.
approvals.policy_desc: Read-only view of the effective approval settings.
approvals.grants_desc: Always and session grants recorded at runtime.
approvals.clear_confirm: Revoke every grant for this agent?

observability.title: Observability
observability.subtitle: Traces, token usage, and cost for the last seven days.

observability.empty_desc: Send a message and the run will appear here.
observability.purge_confirm: Delete every recorded run for this agent?
observability.select_run: Select a run to inspect its spans.
